Prosecutor Alleges Gang Leader Orchestrated Tupac Shakur Shooting

Duane 'Keffe D' Davis, a former gang leader, is accused by prosecutors of orchestrating the 1996 drive-by shooting that killed rapper Tupac Shakur. The accusation was made during a court proceeding where Davis was formally charged. Prosecutors presented their case to a jury, detailing Davis's alleged role in masterminding the murder. Davis was arrested in September 2023 in connection with the decades-old case.
